name: rm-pos
description: RM POS — hardware store POS desktop app (React + Electron)
author: Ali Afrash <aliafrash.repairme@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,app,api -c yellow,cyan,green "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ." "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.live: concurrently -k -n web,app,api -c yellow,cyan,green "cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ." "cross-env PORT=4100 npm --prefix server run live:start"
